scene: Inside the rumbling cab, miniature rainclouds leak through the open dashboard vents.
beats: The speaker blares a cheerful electric jingle. Static sparks across the cab just as the truck brakes hard inside the buzzing, glowing neon workshop.
You scoop the cool puff into your palm; it tickles and condenses into sweet lime drizzle as the truck halts among giant luminous letters.
Inside lies a glowing glass tube shaped like an ampersand. You tuck it under your arm and step directly onto the repair room floor.
picture: Inside the flat-bench tow truck cab. A burly driver steers on the far left next to a glowing radio dial. The player sits centre in his corduroy jacket and beanie. Up high drifts a tiny raining cloud. On the right bench sits a green toolbox, with rooftop tanks visible through windows.
shown: a crackling dashboard radio with a glowing red dial on the left
a tiny puffy grey stormcloud drifting near the ceiling up high
